_comment: Example only. Copy to config/hosts.local.json (git-ignored), replace paths and remotes, and adapt commands to your repositories. Keep credentials, keys, tokens and agent sockets outside this repo.
_note: One routing home owns runs/ for every project. Host IDs are arbitrary; --host and --from accept configured IDs. For multiple hosts of one OS, set ROUTE_HOST or hosts.<id>.match.hostname. See docs/adding-a-project.md.
_worker_args_note: Native worker flags enable automatic approval. The orchestrator must listen and answer any remaining dialog within the recorded grant.

allowed: the project's issue workflow up to the stop point: commit and push the task's own branch and open ONE draft PR, only once every required check is green

checkpoint pushes: at least every ~60 min of work, push the task's own branch, so no work sits only in the worktree. Push your real commits, or commit the worktree's changes as 'WIP (checkpoint): <issue> [skip ci]'. A checkpoint is never a PR: that still waits for every required check to be green. Pushed history is never rewritten (force-push stays forbidden): bring main in by merging, not rebasing

to move the task to the other machine only, when the orchestrator asks: one work-in-progress commit of the worktree's changes on the task's own branch, subject 'WIP (host move): <issue> [skip ci]', pushed to that branch with no PR; the next task starts a worktree at that commit and re-verifies everything before any PR
forbidden: force-push or push any branch but the task's own
anything the project reserves for the parent or human (merge, ready-for-review, status transitions, deploy, staging/provider writes)
git pull/reset/clean/checkout/stash in the main checkout
stop other agents
change security settings

allowed: read the PR diff, the issue and the repo; focus the review on the diff
run focused checks (unit tests, typecheck, lint) in the issue's worktree when needed to confirm or rule out a finding, each wrapped in scripts/heavy

start the project's Compose stack or full readiness gate (that's a gate task)

review.stop_condition: One review verdict (APPROVE or CHANGES_REQUIRED) with findings tied to file:line, against the PR head SHA.

allowed: git fetch; run the project's staging session helper from the task's own detached worktree at origin/main (no edits)
sign in to the staging app only as the configured test roles, through the session prepared by scripts/credentials.sh, when the human grants staging access
browse the test role screens and walk the flows the review needs
create synthetic test data in the staging test tenant through the app UI

forbidden: read, print, copy or log a password or a session file's contents; type a password anywhere (the session helper signs in, never you)
sign in to production, or as any account other than the staging test roles
change accounts, users, passwords, invites, tenant, billing or security settings; delete data you didn't create
trigger external provider writes or messages to real recipients from staging
attach screenshots or session data to the tracker or PR; report findings as text

staging-review.stop_condition: Each check recorded as pass or fail with what was seen, every piece of test data created listed, and the session files removed (scripts/credentials.sh --clear).

linux.description: Linux workstation: web, Docker and infrastructure checks.
linux._capabilities_note: Advertise only installed and usable tools. Project profiles do not add requirements automatically; each task supplies --requires.
linux._path_note: Non-interactive SSH shells skip shell startup files; list the actual tool directories on this machine.

web-app._note: Use the pnpm version pinned by this repo. Runtime ports belong here because capacity and port ranges can differ by host.

port_slots._note: Slot 0 is reserved for the main checkout. Task slot n adds n*step to each base port. Every published runtime port must use its exported variable; extra_env can substitute {task_id}.

mobile._note: Plain git worktrees resolve the project dir template under this root; the main checkout is preserved.

infra._note: Plain git worktrees resolve the project dir template under this root; the main checkout is preserved.

linux._reach_note: reach keys identify the SOURCE host. The selector is the TARGET profile label saved on that source; ssh_alias is its OpenSSH alias for probes and preflight.
linux._capacity_note: Starting values, not hardware guarantees. Heavy slots are shared across every project on this machine. A lower share gives a daily-use laptop less work; measure before raising caps.

tracker_flow._note: The latest completed step in pipeline order implies its mapped status; rank detects a tracker status lag. The router never moves tracker issues.

worktree._note: Example repository helper: provide scripts/issue-worktree.sh in web-app, or replace create/check with your existing helper. It must create this dir and branch at the exact commit and honor the deps/env modes. See docs/adding-a-project.md.

env_notes.POSTGRES_HOST_PORT: Host-side DB commands must use port $POSTGRES_HOST_PORT (export DATABASE_URL in this shell); never edit a shared or symlinked .env.

brief._note: Examples enter worker briefs; they do not run a gate. env_notes appear only for variables exported for this task.

staging._note: Credential store names, not secrets. Supply a repo helper that reads credentials on stdin and writes browser storage state to {out}; placeholders must be whole arguments.

pr._note: Checkout used by gh pr list on the routing home, not a worker worktree. Omit to disable PR lookup for this project.

mobile._note: Native verification tasks request ios-simulator or android-emulator; those capabilities are available only on mac. Web-only tasks may still run on Linux.

infra._note: Only linux advertises opentofu. Request it explicitly. This profile has no package manager, tracker, Compose runtime or staging login.
